results.title: GTA 6 Leak: Who Is Cyberleek and Why Is the Hacker Targeting Rockstar Games?
results.description: A hacker known as Cyberleek has leaked "Grand Theft Auto VI" gameplay footage and a map, demanding Rockstar apologize for digital-only sales, while promoting a crypto token that has drawn skepticism from preservationists.
